title: Account Entry
description: Sherkety ERP's invoice, bill, credit note and journal entry: one page (account.move, view_move_form) whose type decides what shows. With what account (currency), sherkety_manual_currency_rate, account_payment, account_debit_note, account_edi, account_distribution_extras, sale and purchase add to it.

show_reset_to_draft_button.label: Show Reset To Draft Button
show_reset_to_draft_button.compute: not restrict_mode_hash_table and (state == 'cancel' or (state == 'posted' and not need_cancel_request))

partner_shipping_id.label: Delivery Address
partner_shipping_id.help: The delivery address will be used in the computation of the fiscal position.

payment_reference.label: Payment Reference
payment_reference.help: The payment reference to set on journal items.

fiscal_position_id.label: Fiscal Position
fiscal_position_id.help: Fiscal positions are used to adapt taxes and accounts for particular customers or sales orders/invoices. The default value comes from the customer.

invoice_cash_rounding_id.label: Cash Rounding Method
invoice_cash_rounding_id.help: Defines the smallest coinage of the currency that can be used to pay by cash.

auto_post.label: Auto-post
auto_post.help: Specify whether this entry is posted automatically on its accounting date, and any similar recurring invoices.

to_check.label: To Check
to_check.help: If this checkbox is ticked, it means that the user was not sure of all the related information at the time of the creation of the move and that the move needs to be checked again.

buttons.label: Send & Print
buttons.invisible: state != 'posted' or is_being_sent or invoice_pdf_report_id or move_type not in ['out_invoice', 'out_refund']

buttons.label: Send & Print
buttons.invisible: state != 'posted' or (not is_being_sent and not invoice_pdf_report_id) or move_type not in ['out_invoice', 'out_refund', 'in_invoice', 'in_refund']

buttons.label: Register Payment
buttons.invisible: state != 'posted' or payment_state not in ['not_paid', 'partial'] or move_type not in ['out_invoice', 'out_refund', 'in_invoice', 'in_refund', 'out_receipt', 'in_receipt'] or authorized_transaction_ids

buttons.label: Capture Transaction
buttons.invisible: move_type not in ['out_invoice', 'out_refund', 'in_invoice', 'in_refund'] or state != 'posted' or not authorized_transaction_ids

buttons.label: Void Transaction
buttons.confirm: Are you sure you want to void the authorized transaction? This action can't be undone.
buttons.invisible: move_type not in ['out_invoice', 'out_refund', 'in_invoice', 'in_refund'] or state != 'posted' or not authorized_transaction_ids

steps.message: Reverse this entry? A reversal is posted on today's date.

buttons.label: Cancel Entry
buttons.invisible: not id or state != 'draft' or move_type != 'entry'

buttons.label: Cancel
buttons.invisible: not id or state != 'draft' or move_type == 'entry'

buttons.label: Request Cancel
buttons.invisible: state != 'posted' or show_reset_to_draft_button or not need_cancel_request

statButtons.label: 1 Payment
statButtons.invisible: move_type != 'entry' or not id or not payment_id

statButtons.label: Reconciled Items
statButtons.invisible: move_type != 'entry' or not id or not has_reconciled_entries

alerts.invisible: move_type != 'in_refund' or not invoice_has_outstanding or payment_state not in ['not_paid', 'partial']
